questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical, beginner-friendly handling of secrets isolation in a real GCP multi-tenant SaaS using common tools.

## Key Concepts

- Tenant-scoped secrets in Secret Manager
- Envelope encryption with per-tenant KMS keys
- Per-tenant IAM/service accounts with least privilege
- Secret access auditing via Cloud Audit Logs
- CI gate validating isolation with synthetic tenants
- Rollback by cleaning synthetic tenants and revoking creds

## Code Example

```bash
# Create a per-tenant secret
gcloud secrets create tenantA-password --replication-policy=REGIONAL --locations=us-central1

# Add a version
echo -n "p@ssw0rd" | gcloud secrets versions add tenantA-password --data-file=-

# Bind access to tenant SA
gcloud secrets add-iam-policy-binding tenantA-password \
  --member="serviceAccount:tenantA-sa@PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you rotate keys across tenants without downtime?
- How would you test cross-tenant access in CI?
